name: Databases / Бази даних
ai_policy: AI allowed for explanations, practice questions, syntax/reference questions. FORBIDDEN: pasting assignment conditions into an AI, asking for solutions, submitting AI-generated SQL/schemas/analysis. Any AI-generated content in a submission must be disclosed with prompts.
assessment: Assignments 1-4: 15 points each = 6 technical correctness + 9 individual defense (2 bank questions + TA questions); skipping the defense = 0 for the whole assignment; after deadline max 7.5
notes: Started late for the student; catch up from week 1. Check SQL by running it on PostgreSQL. Main book: Silberschatz, Korth, Sudarshan 'Database System Concepts' 7th ed. (DSC7).

topics.title: DBMS purpose, data models, schemas and instances; first SQL (SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT)
Relational model, keys, integrity constraints, ER modelling, normalization and anomalies
SQL and relational algebra: joins, aggregation, GROUP BY/HAVING, set operations, subqueries, CTEs, NULLs
How databases store data: files, pages, records, buffer pool, locality
Indexes, B+ trees, selectivity, query plans and EXPLAIN
LSM trees: memtables, SSTables, compaction, Bloom filters, amplification
Transactions and concurrency: ACID, anomalies, isolation levels, locks, deadlocks, MVCC
Durability and recovery: write-ahead logging, checkpoints, redo, undo
OLTP vs OLAP, row vs column storage, compression
